top_concerns: Guarantee is proven for idealised exact interpolant marginals with compact support; learned networks and mixed continuous/categorical molecule variables are outside the theory, so 'provably guarantees' is overstated
Missing baseline: re-parameterising experts to a common noise schedule (or clipping/annealing guidance) could remove heterogeneity and the need for ACE
Molecular evaluation is small and statistically thin (few pockets, no confidence intervals, no diversity/novelty/PoseBusters metrics); w chosen on the test benchmark; Vina rewards strong guidance
Internal inconsistencies in Table 3 (NR vs FKC at w=1.0 differ on SBDD Vina; non-monotone FKC at w=1.4; w=1.1 does not collapse as predicted)
ACE changes intermediate marginals; B is tuned post hoc, large B inflates weight variance, and no ESS/runtime/bump-placement ablations are given
